I'm a student who spends way too much free time coding, and I'm always listening to music or looking for new music to listen to. TODO! Alright, I think I’m for sure back in my indie jpop phase. I listened to the original version of this song a lot last year and didn’t like the remix much then, but now I think this remix is better than the original! I really like the instruments and sounds in the background. It makes the song sound a lot more unique and upbeat. Yeah the instrument that goes “wuh-wuh” and the trumpets around the chorus really tie it together. I haven't listened to a ton of One Direction, but I really like this song that my friend sent me a while back. I've definitely heard this song on the radio, and though it doesn't really do anything for me, it's still a pretty nice song. It's definitely pretty nostalgic, though. It brings me back to when I was little and made sure to get my parents to turn on the radio every time I rode on the car. For sure, I think the main reason this song stands out to me is nostalgia. I’m not sure I would like it nearly as much if I had only recently found it. Here's a chill song from Still Woozy, an artist I've listened to for a while. I really like how laid-back it is without sounding boring. I also found the video pretty interesting, with what I assume is some insecurity or anxiety being represented through the tree and the man constantly feeling the need to prove it wrong. Woah yeah! I should've read the text in the music video, because it definitely adds a lot of meaning to the song. I’ve been listening to this song recently: Alright, this might be a longshot question, but have you ever listened to Atarashii Gakko? I think I’ve heard of them before, but I’ve never listened to any songs. One song by them's been in my mind lately, and it's pretty interesting. Woah, that song is really fun, especially with the video. It kind of felt like I was watching a drama. I don’t know if I would listen to it regularly, but it’s definitely super interesting. Yeah! It's so refreshing compared to the other stuff I usually listen to. All of their songs are a real departure from the mainstream, so I agree with you that it's not something I'd often listen to, but I keep coming back to this song from time to time. And they put so much energy into the video! It really does feel like a drama. I originally found this song through one of my dance teachers a couple years ago, but I've never seen the music video until now and it's pretty interesting. That music video definitely fits the song, and the lyrics are very meaningful, but it’s probably not the type of song I’d listen to every day. The bit at the end does get me hyped, though! I’ve only just discovered this song by Paramore, but man, I really wish I found it earlier. It’s gotta be the one thing that’s improving my running pace right now. Yeah I love how energetic the song is, so it's definitely a song I would listen to when exercising. But because of how repetitive it is, I think I would get tired of it if I were just listening to it by itself. The fact that I left it on loop and forgot about it while coding earlier today isn’t helping its chances either; I’m definitely tired of it now. I’ll definitely still use it as a workout song, because its steady rhythm really helps me out. Here's a fun song that I think feels a lot like summer. I love that chorus! The subtle audio distortion when he yells, “We talk too much!” gives it some extra oomph, which is pretty nice. I’m with you 100% on the summer feel, and the music video contributes a lot to it as well. Here’s a pretty chill song I’ve been listening to lately! Ooh, I really like the trumpets(?) near the end that make the song feel a lot more upbeat. Damn, nice find! I never noticed them consciously but they definitely add to the song. And now that I’ve listened to the song more closely (I usually just listen to songs in the background while doing work), I’m finding that the lyrics are pretty nice and the story they tell is lovely. This is one of my favorite Reneé Rapp songs, but I don’t know if this video really matches what the song is like. Hmm yeah, I think the original music video fits the mood better. The song is beautiful, though. I can definitely relate to the theme of sentimentality (nostalgia?) that it has. Yeah her voice sounds so good too, and she expresses that sentiment so well. I haven’t seen the music video yet, so I’ll have to watch that. Oh man, her voice is really something. I don’t often hear songs that go that high and that loud for the chorus. NEW CLARIO! I’ve been hearing about this song recently, but it’s my first time actually listening to it. I really like how it manages to be upbeat yet relaxed at the same time. I totally agree! I love how the bright synths and high-tempo drums combine with the laid back vocals. Well, right now I’m debating whether to listen to this song a lot upfront and risk getting tired of it or be disciplined to avoid that. Yeah when I find a new song I really like, I try to dilute my listening with similar songs or other songs from the same artist to avoid getting sick of it. That's a good idea.
